name: boxtrack
description: BoxTrack - Mudanzas Corporativas, Inventario QR por Bulto & Self-Storage

scripts.version:bump: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const v = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('version.json', 'utf8')); const parts = v.version.slice(1).split('.'); parts[2] = String(Number(parts[2]) + 1).padStart(2, '0'); const nextSemver = parts.join('.'); v.version = 'v' + nextSemver; fs.writeFileSync('version.json', JSON.stringify(v, null, 2) + '\n'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); pkg.version = nextSemver; fs.writeFileSync('package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n'); let sw = fs.readFileSync('sw.js', 'utf8'); sw = sw.replace(/boxtrack-cache-v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+/g, 'boxtrack-cache-' + v.version); fs.writeFileSync('sw.js', sw); let html = fs.readFileSync('index.html', 'utf8'); html = html.replace(/BoxTrack v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+/g, 'BoxTrack ' + v.version); html = html.replace(/Versión v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+/g, 'Versión ' + v.version); fs.writeFileSync('index.html', html); console.log('Bumped to', v.version);"
